messages:
emma: alert: VelaMarkets (acct_velam) showing sustained token-per-second spike at 2024-03-12T11:00:00Z. burst credits dropped from 1200 -> 0, many 429s seen.
raj: got it. can someone paste a sample 429 payload?

emma: sample from proxy logs:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "admission_reject",
  "reason": "headroom_limit",
  "account": "acct_velam",
  "burst_credits": 0
}
```

tina (support): customer reports two bursts: a scheduled newsletter + internal load tests. they saw failures starting ~11:02 UTC, ~25% of generation calls failed with 429.
lucas (eng-sre): looking at admission and pool metrics. admission controller refused new sessions due to headroom threshold hit. pool GPUs are 70% utilized but queue depth rose quickly.

raj: did autoscaler attempt to add capacity or use burst capacity?
lucas: autoscaler blocked from adding because shard-level reservation reached hard limit on that region. burst credits were 0 so burst-add path wasn't allowed.

tina: customer sent x-request-ids: vm-4a2f, vm-4a33 for correlation.
raj: grabbing logs for those ids.

ops-bot: ingest-processor: duplicate usage events detected for acct_velam in last 10m; marking for correction.

olga (billing): found billing correction entry around 11:01:58Z where a correction job applied -1200 burst credits for acct_velam citing duplicate_event_prune.
lucas: so credits removed mid-spike. that's likely why admission started rejecting.

tina: customer is upset and needs immediate unblock. they want an explanation + recovery now.
carla (acct-exec): customer on enterprise plan; authorize temporary top-up and failover. propose +1500 credits and model fallback.

lucas: short-term playbook we can run now:
- grant manual burst credits +1500
- enable model-fallback to smaller model for acct_velam
- open high-priority ticket to billing

raj: running grant now.

```
$ admin grant-burst acct_velam 1500 --by raj --note "emergency top-up: newsletter spike"
=> OK new_burst_credits=1500
```

lucas: monitoring: admission reject rate for acct_velam drops from 25% -> 3% within 60s. queue depth falls.
tina: customer confirms traffic now mostly served, appreciates the quick patch.

lucas: enabling fallback route for acct_velam to model: small-gen-quant

```
proxy: apply rule { match account==acct_velam -> route to small-gen-quant when admission_reject }
```

lucas: fallback applied; about 40% of new sessions now routed to fallback. latency improved.

olga: investigating why correction applied during active spike: correction job logic dedupes events then computes delta and applies immediately. but dedupe finished late and correction hit while spike ongoing.

raj: repro in staging to validate gating: plan
1) simulate sustained 3x baseline token usage for 8m
2) inject duplicate events then run correction job
3) observe admission behavior, burst credits change, and autoscaler actions

lucas: ran staging repro: when correction applied mid-spike, admission rejects rose sharply even though GPU headroom existed. root cause: correction blindly writes burst credit deltas without consulting admission state.

tina: customer asks for commitments: will this recur?
carla: recommend: (a) delay corrections when admission.reject_rate > 5% for enterprise accounts, (b) add a short hold window before applying large negative adjustments, (c) add alerting on correction jobs that modify credits > X.
olga: agree. immediate changes I will make:
- add admission-state check to correction runner
- threshold hold: if active_reject_rate > 5% hold corrections and notify billing team
- add audit log for any auto-adjust > 500 credits

lucas: will draft code change to correction runner and a proxy rule to prefer fallback when corrections queued.

raj: customer follow-up: offered a 30-day mitigation credit and an architecture review call.
tina: customer accepted the temporary top-up and wants a post-incident writeup.

lucas: post-incident notes:
- impact: ~25% 429s for ~6m for VelaMarkets, partial recovery after manual +1500 credits and model fallback.
- proximate cause: auto-correction job removed burst credits during peak due to late dedupe of duplicate events.
- contributing: no gate on applying large negative corrections during high admission rejection.
- remediation: add gating logic, add canary apply for enterprise, tighten event ingestion dedupe, alerting.

carla: scheduled 1:1 with VelaMarkets CTO and ops team to review headroom sizing and recommended guardrails.

tina: marking support ticket as resolved for now; will attach postmortem once ready.

raj: adding :white_check_mark: and closing thread. if correction runner is patched we'll re-open to validate.

emma: closing monitoring alert and setting a follow-up for 2h to watch credit levels.
